items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And he was replaced by Cliff Holman, originally from Birmingham, Alabama.

ctx.x: My next oldest brother, Johnny, Johnny Riddick, played piano in one of the finest Dixieland jazz bands in the 20s. He was six years in the Arcadia Ballroom in St. Louis. He was with the Arcadian Serenaders. The original name of the band was the Crescent City Jazzers. They originated in Mobile, Gulfport, and New Orleans. Wingy Munoon was one of the first trumpet players in that band. And Harry Tolson was one of the first clarinet players in that band, but he left that band pretty soon. And he was replaced by Cliff…
I didn't know that. That somehow slipped my attention.
